picker.title: Choose a folder for the seabag
language.label: Language
notice.created_here: Created a seabag with a starter project in .fliphopper/seabag/ inside this empty folder.
notice.created_here_readme: Created a seabag with a starter project in .fliphopper/seabag/ inside this empty folder, and README-fliphopper.md to say what the folder is.
notice.created_nested: Created a seabag with a starter project in .fliphopper/seabag/.
pending.title: No seabag in this folder yet
pending.body: {folder} has other files but no FlipHopper seabag.
pending.git: It is inside the Git repository {repo}. Your task files will be versioned by that repository; FlipHopper does not create a second one and does not run Git.
welcome.title: Your project's tasks, in a folder you choose.
welcome.body: Pick a folder. If it already holds a seabag, FlipHopper shows its tasks grouped by area. Otherwise FlipHopper creates the seabag, with a small starter project, in {dir} inside that folder: right away when the folder is empty, and after asking when it has other files, such as a code repository.
box.empty: This seabag has no areas or tasks yet.
box.no_project: The project file could not be read, so no tasks are shown. Fix the problem above.
issues.label: Problems in this seabag
problem.not_json: This file could not be read as JSON for FlipHopper: {detail}.
problem.field_unknown: FlipHopper does not know this field. Check its spelling, or remove it.
problem.invalid_choice: {value} is not a valid value here. Use one of: {allowed}.
problem.invalid_id: "{id}" is not a valid ID. Use 1–64 letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
problem.wrong_format: Expected "{expected}" but found "{found}". This version of FlipHopper reads only "{expected}".
problem.ladder_empty: The label ladder needs at least one step.
problem.duplicate_area_id: Another area already uses the ID "{id}".
problem.duplicate_task_id: Another task already uses the ID "{id}".
problem.unknown_area: The area "{area}" does not exist. Add areas/{area}.json or use an existing area ID.
problem.label_not_on_ladder: "{label}" is not a step of this project's ladder ({ladder}).
problem.waiting_on_missing: A waiting task must say what it is waiting on.
problem.task_file_missing: This task folder has no task.json.
problem.folder_not_empty: {path} is not empty, so no seabag was created there.
problem.create_failed: Could not create the seabag in {path}: {detail}.
problem.seabag_not_found: No seabag was found at or above {path}. Run `fh init` first, or pass --seabag <path>.
problem.seabag_unreadable: The seabag at {path} could not be read: {detail}
problem.seabag_busy: Another FlipHopper writer is changing the seabag at {path}. Try again in a moment.
problem.holder_missing: Say who you are with --as <name> or the FLIPHOPPER_HOLDER environment variable.
problem.task_closed: Task {id} is {state}, so it cannot be changed this way.
problem.label_below_top: Finished with the label "{label}", below the top step "{top}".
problem.open_failed: Could not open {path} in the file manager: {detail}.
problem.startup_not_a_folder: FlipHopper was started with {path}, which is not a folder, so nothing was opened.
